verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a managed vector database, and a database could plausibly be open source, so this axis applies. The pack shows no open-licensed source for the product. The public pinecone-io/pinecone-api GitHub repository holds only OpenAPI specs, not the database's source, and a community comment calls Pinecone "anti-FOSS".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
